real_cells: maximum 400 unique per target; never duplicate scarce reference
template_scope: evaluation-only oracle on hash-fixed half panel; residual and pathway diagnostics on disjoint other half; no predictor input
pathways: hash-frozen Reactome; minimum 5 measured members; no alias guessing
score_scope: frozen official six metrics and freshly rebuilt baseline/5 anchors per exact panel; preserve undefined metrics and failed bundle reasons; no leaderboard submission
template_projection: unit rank-one orthogonal direction; all panel target genes excluded from diagnostics

power_diagnostic.sampling: without replacement from the SAME generated 400-cell population to actual real n
